blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate Majority Leader Juan Miguel Zubiri on Thursday described as “alarming” the billions in tourism revenue losses incurred by Palawan and Siargao. The losses, he said, was attributable to the transfer of turboprop flights from Ninoy Aquino International Airport (Naia) in Manila to the Clark International Airport in Pampanga. “The loss of total economic activity in El Nido is P7.6 billion. In Coron, it is P10.61 billion loss. In Siargao po, P14.2 billion,” Zubiri said, citing reports from the Department of Tourism, “These are alarming, Sir. Sec, alarming ‘to, Sec.
